responsibility: Declares helper data structures and expansion interfaces used by the x86 backend’s RTL generation support code. It provides the vector-permutation descriptor, constants such as the maximum vector length, and prototypes for PIC/TLS symbol legalization, builtin expansion, vector permutation handling, reduction splitting, division/modulus libcall expansion, and related low-level expand helpers implemented outside the main i386.cc target file.
same_name_distinction: Unlike i386-expand.cc, which implements the expansion helpers, this header provides their shared declarations and small support definitions such as MAX_VECT_LEN and expand_vec_perm_d for use across the i386 backend.
